page_title: CRE 0-0 TOR | Cremonese v Torino 19/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
90+5' Torino get a corner.
90+5' Sandro Kulenovic (Torino) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Today's match ends for Alieu Njie who will be replaced by Sandro Kulenovic (Torino).

85' Milan Djuric (Cremonese) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Alberto Paleari displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
84' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) replacing Sebastiano Luperto.
84' The game has come to an end for Antonio Sanabria. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Milan Djuric (Cremonese).
80' It's like he was asking for a caution. Enzo Ebosse (Torino) receives a yellow card.
80' The referee gives a yellow card to Alieu Njie (Torino).
78' Saul Coco (Torino) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
76' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Rafael Obrador will be replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino).
76' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Nikola Vlasic is replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Torino).
76' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alberto Paleari intercepts the ball.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Grassi departs the field of play to be replaced by Martin Payero (Cremonese).
71' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) picks up an injury.
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Alieu Njie (Torino) coming on for Giovanni Simeone.
68' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Guillermo Maripan and he is replaced by Luca Marianucci (Torino).
66' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Cremonese players look gutted.
63' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Cremonese can stand using VAR.
61' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) directs the ball towards goal with a precise header and it hits the back of the net!
60' Marco Giampaolo has decided to make a change. David Okereke (Cremonese) replaces Jari Vandeputte.
60' A substitution has been made. Romano Floriani is replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese).
58' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cremonese.
52' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
52' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cremonese.
50' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) almost scores with a cheeky low shot towards goal that goes under the defensive wall, but Alberto Paleari is alert and makes a good save.
44' Cremonese have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
42' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
41' The foul by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
28' Cremonese have been awarded a corner kick.
27' That's a free kick to Cremonese.

22' Cremonese are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
15' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) fails to get a shot on target, as the well positioned defensive wall comfortably deals with his free kick.

14' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Torino, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
12' Enzo Ebosse (Torino) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Fabbri signals.
11' Corner kick. Cremonese will have an opportunity.
7' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alberto Paleari, who smothers the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Torino will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
